name: Parcel Sentry – Fake COD Order Blocker for WooCommerce
author: kovaja

sections.description:
Every refused Cash on Delivery parcel costs you shipping both ways, packing time and stock that sits in a courier warehouse. Parcel Sentry stops fake COD orders before you ship them.

It is built for stores in markets where Cash on Delivery is the main payment method, such as Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, the Gulf countries, Egypt, Morocco, Nigeria and Kenya, and it works for any WooCommerce store that offers COD.

Every feature is free. There is no locked “Pro” feature in this plugin.

Blocklist and allowlist

  • Block customers by phone number, email address, email domain (@domain.com) or IP address, including IP ranges (1.2.3.0/24) and wildcards (1.2.3.*).
  • Smart matching: 0300-1234567, +92 300 1234567 and 00923001234567 are treated as the same number. Gmail dots and “+tags” are matched too, so j.o.h.n+test@gmail.com matches john@gmail.com.
  • Choose what happens to a blocked customer: hide Cash on Delivery only (they can still pay online) or reject the order completely.
  • Temporary blocks that expire after a set number of days.
  • Trusted customers (allowlist) skip every check.
  • Block or trust a customer with one click from the order screen, or in bulk from the orders list.
  • CSV import and export.

Automatic block after refused deliveries

  • Adds a Refused order status. Stock is restored automatically when a parcel comes back.
  • After a set number of refused orders (2 by default), the customer’s phone and email are blocked automatically.

COD rules

Hide Cash on Delivery when:

  • The order total is below a minimum or above a maximum.
  • A first-time customer orders above a set amount.
  • The cart has too many items.
  • The customer is a guest.
  • The delivery country is not on your list, or the postcode or city is blocked (wildcards supported).
  • The cart contains selected products or categories (sub-categories included).
  • The same customer already placed too many COD orders in the last hours.

Phone validation

  • Rejects fake numbers such as 0000000000 or 123456789.
  • Strict mobile number check for more than 30 countries, plus a length check for every other country.
  • Can apply to COD orders only, or to all orders.

Risk score for every COD order

Each new COD order gets a score from 0 to 100, shown in the orders list and on the order screen with the reasons behind it:

  • Previous refused orders
  • First-time customer
  • Many orders from the same IP address
  • Another open order with the same phone or email
  • Invalid phone number
  • Disposable email address
  • Billing and shipping locations differ
  • Incomplete delivery address
  • High order value
  • Suspicious name (“test”, “asdf”, names with numbers)

You choose the points for each signal. High-risk orders can be put on hold automatically, trigger an email alert, or be refused at checkout above a score you choose.

Customer order confirmation

  • Customers confirm their order with one click from a private link in the order email.
  • Send the same link on WhatsApp from the order screen with one click. No API account is needed.
  • Orders wait “On hold” and move to “Processing” when confirmed.
  • Customers who did not place the order can cancel it, and stock is restored.
  • Unconfirmed orders are cancelled automatically after a set number of hours.
  • Ask every COD customer, or only medium and high-risk ones.

Dashboard and activity log

  • See blocked attempts, high-risk orders, refusals and confirmations for the last 30 days.
  • Searchable activity log with automatic cleanup.

Compatibility

  • WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the legacy order storage.
  • The block-based Cart and Checkout and the classic shortcode checkout.
  • Any Cash on Delivery gateway: choose which payment methods Parcel Sentry protects.
  • WPML and Polylang: all customer messages can be translated.
  • Page caching plugins: the confirmation page is never cached.
  • Multisite.
  • Checkout field editor plugins, because all data is read from the order.

Privacy

Parcel Sentry does not send any data to external services. Everything is stored in your own database. The plugin adds suggested text to your privacy policy and supports the WordPress personal data export and erase tools.

The WhatsApp button only opens a wa.me link in your browser when you click it.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate it. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Parcel Sentry to review the settings. Sensible defaults are on from the start.
  4. Open WooCommerce > Parcel Sentry to manage the blocklist and see blocked attempts.
sections.faq:
Does it work with the new block checkout?

Yes. Parcel Sentry supports both the block checkout and the classic checkout.

Will blocked customers still be able to buy?

By default they can still pay with any other payment method; only Cash on Delivery is removed. You can switch to rejecting their orders completely.

My COD gateway is not the WooCommerce default one.

Choose your gateway under Protected payment methods in the General settings.

How do I mark a parcel as refused?

Change the order status to Refused, either on the order screen or with the bulk action in the orders list. After the number of refusals you set, the customer is blocked automatically.

Can I override the confirmation page design?

Yes. Copy templates/confirm-order.php to yourtheme/parcel-sentry/confirm-order.php and edit it.

Does the order confirmation work with page caching?

Yes. The confirmation page sends no-cache headers and tells common caching plugins not to cache it.

Can developers extend it?

Yes. Filters include parcel_sentry_cod_gateways, parcel_sentry_risk_result, parcel_sentry_restriction_result, parcel_sentry_validate_order, parcel_sentry_phone_patterns, parcel_sentry_is_valid_phone, parcel_sentry_disposable_email_domains and parcel_sentry_whatsapp_message. Actions include parcel_sentry_order_processed, parcel_sentry_order_confirmed and parcel_sentry_customer_auto_blocked.
